armored: At the start of each round, incoming damage is reduced to a random value between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}} of its original amount.
dwarf: At the start of each round, your size is randomly set to between {{minScale|multiplier}} and {{maxScale|multiplier}} of its normal size.
friendlyfire: Shooting teammates heals them for {{healthDamageMultiplier|percent}} of the damage dealt.
miner: Your HE grenades detonate only when an enemy is within {{detonationRange}} units. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
reactivearmor: Your armor blocks the first hit you take, then recharges after {{cooldown|seconds}}.
shade: Each hit has a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to teleport you {{teleportDistance}} units behind the enemy.
soundmaker: You scream every {{cooldown|seconds}}, revealing your presence to nearby players.
demoneye: You deal {{damage}} damage to every enemy you are looking at every {{secondCooldown|seconds}}.
thorns: Attackers receive {{healthTakenScale|percent}} of the damage they deal to you, capped at {{maxTakenDamagePerShot}} damage per shot.
dash: Jump again while airborne to dash with {{jumpVelocity}} upward velocity and {{pushVelocity}} forward velocity. Can dash in any direction: {{anyDirection}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
ninja: Standing still increases your invisibility by {{idlePercentInvisibility|percent}}, crouching by {{duckPercentInvisibility|percent}}, and holding a knife by {{knifePercentInvisibility|percent}}.
throwingknife: Click [css_useSkill] to throw a knife that deals {{damage}} damage. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}.
explosiveshot: Each shot has a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to create an explosion that deals {{damage}} damage within {{damageRadius}} units.
baseball: Your decoy moves at {{speedMultipier|multiplier}} its normal speed, up to a maximum velocity of {{maxSpeed}}, and deals {{damageDeal}} damage on impact. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
hermit: Killing restores ammo and {{healthToAdd}} health. Effect duration: {{effectDuration|seconds}}.
planter: You can plant the bomb anywhere, with {{extraC4BlowTime|seconds}} added to its detonation time.
knockback: Firing while airborne pushes you backward with {{knockbackUnits}} force, up to a maximum speed of {{maxSpeed}}.
flashlight: Click [css_useSkill] to toggle a flashlight with a range of {{range}} units and {{brightness|multiplier}} the normal brightness. It blinds enemies within {{blindAngle}} degrees of your aim for {{blindDuration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
antyflash: You are immune to flashbangs. Enemies hit by your flashbangs are blinded for {{flashDuration|seconds}}. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
anomaly: Click [css_useSkill] to rewind {{secondsInBack|seconds}} back in time. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
gambler: Select a skill from the list. Refreshing the list costs {{refreshPrice|currency}}.
smoker: You have unlimited smoke grenades, with up to {{grenadeLimit}} active at once.
assassin: Attacks from behind deal {{damageMultiplier|multiplier}} the normal damage when your angle is within {{toleranceDeg}} degrees.
healingsmoke: Your smoke restores {{smokeHeal}} health every {{tickCooldown}} to players within {{smokeRadius}} units. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
deathbomb: You explode upon death for {{explosionDamage}} damage in a {{explosionRadius}} unit radius. Teammate damage is reduced by {{dmgReductionForTeamates|percent}}.
thirdeye: Click [css_useSkill] to activate third person view at a distance of {{distance}} units.
takeammo: Click [css_useSkill] to take the active weapon magazine from a random enemy. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
hotbomb: While you are alive, the bomb carrier takes {{damage}} damage every {{cooldown|seconds}}.
carefulbullets: Select a player who takes {{damageAfterMiss}} damage for every missed shot.
spectator: Click [css_useSkill] to spectate a random enemy from {{distance}} units away. Update interval: {{useCooldown|seconds}}.
magneticdecoy: Your decoy pulls players within {{triggerRadius}} units toward it with {{strenght}} strength. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
astronaut: At the start of each round, gravity is randomly set to between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}} of normal gravity.
holyhandgrenade: Your HE grenades deal {{damageMultiplier|multiplier}} the normal damage and have {{damageRadiusMultiplier|multiplier}} the normal explosion radius. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
fortnite: Click [css_useSkill] to create a barricade with {{barricadeHealth}} health. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
toxicsmoke: Your smoke deals {{smokeDamage}} damage every {{tickCooldown}} to players within {{smokeRadius}} units. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
glaz: You can see through smoke. Up to {{grenadeLimit}} smoke grenades can be active at once.
longknife: Knife attacks reach up to {{maxDistance}} units. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}.
chicken: You get a chicken model, move faster, and have reduced health.
catapult: Each hit has a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to launch the enemy upward.
frozendecoy: Your decoy slows players within {{triggerRadius}} units to {{slownessMultiplier|multiplier}} of their normal movement speed. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
pilot: Press jump twice to start flying. Maximum fuel: {{maximumFuel}}. Fuel consumption rate: {{fuelConsumption}}. Refueling rate: {{refuelling}}.
healingchicken: You spawn {{amount}} chickens that restore {{heal}} health every {{tickCooldown}} to players within {{healRadius}} units.
killerflash: Anyone fully blinded by your flashbang for {{flashDuration|seconds}} dies. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
push: Each hit has a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to push the enemy with {{pushVelocity}} horizontal velocity and {{jumpVelocity}} upward velocity.
expensiveammo: A chosen enemy pays {{moneyPerShot|currency}} for every shot.
watchmaker: Each grenade you throw changes the remaining round time by {{changeRoundTime|seconds}}.
retreat: Click [css_useSkill] to return to spawn. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
swapposition: Click [css_useSkill] to swap places with a random enemy after {{cooldownBeforeUse|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
teamteleport: Press [css_useSkill] to teleport to a teammate within {{teleportDistance}} units and {{teleportAngle}} degrees of your aim. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
pyro: Molotov damage restores health equal to {{regenerationMultiplier|multiplier}} of the damage dealt. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
disarmament: Each hit has a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to make the enemy drop their weapon.
magnifier: Choose an enemy and set their field of view to {{customFOV}} degrees.
secondlife: After lethal damage, you respawn with {{startHealth}} health.
replicator: Click [css_useSkill] to create a replica. It deals {{enemyTeamDamage}} damage to enemies and {{yourTeamDamage}} damage to teammates. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
tripwire: Place a tripwire up to {{maxWallDistance}} units long, {{wireHeight}} units high, and {{wireWidth}} units wide. Enemies within {{triggerRadius}} units trigger it and remain visible for {{radarDuration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
jester: Jester mode prevents dealing and receiving damage. The mode changes after a random interval between {{minTime|seconds}} and {{maxTime|seconds}}.
weightless: Your grenades ignore gravity and fly faster. Up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades can be active at once.
dracula: Damage dealt to enemies restores health equal to {{healthRegainScale|percent}} of the damage dealt.
illusionist: Click [css_useSkill] to deploy a replica. It lasts {{durationRun|seconds}} while running or {{durationCrouch|seconds}} while crouching, deals {{enemyTeamDamage}} damage to enemies, and deals {{yourTeamDamage}} damage to teammates. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
iana: Click [css_useSkill] to control your hologram for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
cypher: Click [css_useSkill] to create or switch to a camera. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
medic: Click [css_useSkill] to restore {{healthToAdd}} health. Charges: {{healthShotLimit}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
enemyspawn: Click [css_useSkill] to teleport to the enemy spawn after {{cooldownBeforeUse|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
nightmare: Choose an enemy to distort their vision for {{fadeTime|seconds}}, with exposure ranging from {{minExposure}} to {{maxExposure}}.
fragilebomb: Shooting the bomb damages it. Bomb health: {{maxBombHealth}}.
lastgasp: After you die, deal {{damageAfterDeath}} damage to your killer. Can kill: {{canKill}}.
phoenix: After taking lethal damage, you have a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to respawn.
magneto: Enemy grenades within {{radius}} units are repelled away from you.
psychicdefusing: When you are within {{maxDefusingRange}} units of the bomb, you defuse it in {{defusingTime|seconds}}.
robinhood: Dealing damage steals money equal to the damage dealt multiplied by {{moneyMultiplier}}.
blastshot: Press Attack2 with the MP5 to fire an HE grenade dealing {{explosionDamage}} damage in a {{explosionRadius}} unit radius with {{force}} force. Teammate damage is reduced by {{dmgReductionForTeamates|percent}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
jumpcurse: A chosen enemy jumps with {{jumpVelocity}} velocity whenever a teammate jumps.
flash: At the start of each round, your movement speed is randomly set to between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}} of its normal value.
rambo: At the start of each round, receive between {{minExtraHealth}} and {{maxExtraHealth}} extra health.
jetkick: Select a player whose shots push them backwards with {{pushVelocity}} velocity.
explodingbarrel: Click [css_useSkill] to place a barrel that explodes for {{explosionDamage}} damage in a {{explosionRadius}} unit radius. Teammate damage is reduced by {{dmgReductionForTeamates|percent}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
berserker: As your health decreases, your movement speed increases up to {{maxSpeedVelocity|multiplier}} its normal value and your damage increases up to {{maxDamageVelocity|multiplier}} its normal value.
poison: Choose a player who takes {{damage}} damage every {{cooldown|seconds}} until reaching {{minHealth}} health.
godmode: Click [css_useSkill] to become immortal for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
blademaster: While holding a knife, you have a {{torseReflectionChance|percent}} chance to deflect torso shots and a {{legReflectionChance|percent}} chance to deflect leg shots. Deflected bullets travel at {{velocityModifier|multiplier}} their normal velocity.
teleporter: Each hit has a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to swap your position with the enemy.
paweljumper: You receive between {{extraJumpsMin}} and {{extraJumpsMax}} extra jumps.
randomweapon: Click [css_useSkill] to receive a random weapon. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
richboy: At the start of each round, receive between {{minMoney|currency}} and {{maxMoney|currency}}.
falconeye: Click [css_useSkill] to activate a bird's eye camera at a distance of {{distance}} units.
longzeus: Zeus attacks reach up to {{maxDistance}} units. Friendly fire: {{friendlyFire}}.
bunnyhop: Automatically bunny hop with {{jumpVelocity}} jump velocity, {{jumpBoost|multiplier}} the normal jump boost, and a maximum speed of {{maxSpeed}}.
weaponsswap: Click [css_useSkill] to swap weapons with a random enemy. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
rubber: Your bullets slow players to {{slownessModifier|multiplier}} of their normal movement speed for {{slownessTime|seconds}}.
soldier: At the start of each round, your damage is randomly set to between {{chanceFrom|multiplier}} and {{chanceTo|multiplier}} of its normal value.
noclip: Click [css_useSkill] to enable noclip for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}. Stuck recovery cooldown: {{cooldownWhenStuck|seconds}}.
aimlock: Click [css_useSkill] to lock your aim for {{duration|seconds}}. Cooldown: {{cooldown|seconds}}.
giant: Choose an enemy and randomly set their size to between {{minScale|multiplier}} and {{maxScale|multiplier}} of their normal size.
behind: Each hit has a chance, randomly set between {{chanceFrom|percent}} and {{chanceTo|percent}}, to turn the enemy in the opposite direction.
homingnades: Your grenades home toward enemies with {{strength}} strength, up to a maximum velocity of {{maxVelocity}}, and detonate when they are within {{detonationRange}} units of a target. You can carry up to {{grenadeLimit}} grenades.
rezombie: After lethal damage, respawn as a zombie with {{zombieHealth}} health and no weapons.
